name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage exploration company focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos silver-gold project in the Salta and Catamarca provinces of Argentina. The Diablillos project hosts a large silver-gold resource and has received approval under Argentina's Large Investment program. The company is actively drilling to expand the resource and advance the project toward a development decision.
